title: OneDrive and SharePoint: expiration for access on main sharing links
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned change and February 2027 target. The existing sharing controls, parameter ranges and product licensing are documented; the briefing appropriately leaves the new feature's default and policy behaviour open.

claims.quote: People can set expiration dates for “Anyone” and “People in your organization” access on the main link to files and folders in OneDrive and SharePoint.

claims.claim: Effective access is the highest permission granted by direct access, a group, a parent folder or site, the hero link or another link.

claims.claim: The Anyone-link expiration setting is at SharePoint admin center > Policies > Sharing > Advanced settings for "Anyone" links > Link expiration.
claims.quote: In the SharePoint admin center, expand Policies, and then select Sharing. / Advanced settings for "Anyone" links / Link expiration - You can require all Anyone links to expire, and specify the maximum number of days allowed.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant accepts CoreAnyoneSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays and OneDriveAnyoneSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays to set Anyone-link maximum lifetimes for SharePoint and OneDrive.
claims.quote: [-OneDriveAnyoneSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays <Int32>] / [-CoreAnyoneSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays <Int32>] / Sets properties on the SharePoint Online organization.

claims.quote: [-OneDriveOrganizationSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays <Int32>] / [-CoreOrganizationSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays <Int32>] / Sets properties on the SharePoint Online organization.

claims.claim: The Anyone link option is available only when the external sharing setting is Anyone.

claims.claim: CoreAnyoneSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays allows 1 to 730 days for all SharePoint sites excluding OneDrive.
claims.quote: Specifies the maximum number of days before Anyone (anonymous) sharing links expire for all SharePoint sites (not including OneDrive sites). / The value can be from 1 to 730 days.

claims.quote: Specifies the maximum number of days before organization sharing links expire for all OneDrive sites. / The value can be from 7 to 720 days.
